tasks.task: Find technical specs for the latest Macbook Air on Apple.
tasks.result:
MacBook Air — Technical Specifications (consolidated; values taken from apple.com/macbook-air/specs/ during this session)

Chip / CPU:
- Apple M5 chip — 10‑core CPU (4 performance + 6 efficiency); GPU options: 8‑core or 10‑core; 16‑core Neural Engine; Media Engine with hardware-accelerated video codecs and AV1 decode (detail observed in earlier extraction on this page).

Memory (RAM):
- 16GB unified memory standard; configurable to 24GB or 32GB (page shows 16GB / 24GB / 32GB configuration rows).

Storage (SSD configurations):
- 512GB SSD (base on some models); configurable to 1TB, 2TB, or 4TB (Storage rows: 512GB, 1TB, configurable to 2TB or 4TB).

Display:
- Liquid Retina display. 13.6‑inch (diagonal) LED‑backlit display with IPS technology; 2560‑by‑1664 native resolution at 224 ppi; 500 nits brightness; support for 1 billion colors; P3 wide color; True Tone.
- (15‑inch model variants also noted on the product pages; the Tech Specs page contains both size entries.)

Battery & Power:
- Up to 18 hours video streaming; up to 15 hours wireless web.
- Built‑in 53.8‑watt‑hour lithium‑polymer battery (13‑inch); 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max; USB‑C to MagSafe 3 Cable (2 m); Fast‑charge capable with 70W or higher USB‑PD power source. (Page shows battery life and adapter details.)

Ports (Charging & Expansion):
- MagSafe 3 charging port.
- Two Thunderbolt 4 (USB‑C) ports (support charging, DisplayPort, Thunderbolt 4 up to 40 Gb/s, USB 4 up to 40 Gb/s).
- 3.5 mm headphone jack.

External Display Support:
- Supports up to two external displays: two displays up to native resolution 6K@60Hz or 4K@144Hz; one display up to 8K@60Hz or 5K@120Hz or 4K@240Hz. Thunderbolt 4 ports support native DisplayPort 1.4 speeds (HBR3) with DSC.

Dimensions (Height × Width × Depth):
- 13‑inch: Height 0.44 inch (1.13 cm); Width 11.97 inches (30.41 cm); Depth 8.46 inches (21.5 cm).
- 15‑inch: Height 0.45 inch (1.15 cm); Width 13.40 inches (34.04 cm); Depth 9.35 inches (23.76 cm).

Weight:
- 13‑inch: 2.7 pounds (1.23 kg) (varies by configuration).
- 15‑inch: 3.3 pounds (1.51 kg) (varies by configuration).

Wireless & Networking:
- Apple N1 wireless chip; Wi‑Fi 7 (802.11be) where available; Bluetooth 6; Thread (as listed on the Tech Specs page).

Camera:
- 12 MP Center Stage camera with Desk View support; 1080p HD video recording and advanced image signal processor (as listed on the product/specs pages).

Audio:
- 13‑inch: Four‑speaker sound system; 15‑inch: Six‑speaker sound system with force‑cancelling woofers. Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos support; three‑mic array with directional beamforming and Voice Isolation/Wide Spectrum modes; 3.5 mm headphone jack support.

In the Box:
- MacBook Air (13‑inch or 15‑inch), 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max, USB‑C to MagSafe 3 Cable (2 m) (page lists included items).

Environmental / Materials Notes:
- Recycled materials details, ENERGY STAR, and packaging info are noted on the Tech Specs page.

Source and verification:
- All values above were observed on the Apple MacBook Air Tech Specs page during this session: https://www.apple.com/macbook-air/specs/.
